name: avenza
description: AVENZA — programmable B2B payments and financial operations on X Layer

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @avenza/api & npm run dev -w @avenza/web & npm run dev -w @avenza/worker
scripts.build: npm run build -w @avenza/shared && npm run build -w @avenza/chain && npm run build -w @avenza/cli && npm run build -w @avenza/api && npm run build -w @avenza/web && npm run build -w @avenza/worker
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @avenza/api --if-present && npm run lint -w @avenza/web --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test -w @avenza/shared --if-present && npm run test -w @avenza/api --if-present && npm run test -w @avenza/chain --if-present
